\dppartgoals{
  \item write a correct binary search every time from a monotone predicate and a loop invariant;
  \item use lower and upper bounds to search, count and answer floor/ceiling queries;
  \item search arrays that are sorted only in pieces: rotated, bitonic, with peaks;
  \item search implicit sequences, functions of the index and sorted matrices.
}
